personalInfo.name: Suman Jha
personalInfo.title: .NET Full Stack Developer
personalInfo.summary: .NET Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience in building and maintaining web applications using C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, Entity Framework, LINQ, and SQL Server. Skilled in Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap with experience in RESTful APIs, microservices, Git, and CI/CD pipelines. Experienced in Agile/Scrum environments, focusing on debugging, performance optimization, and third-party integrations.

experience.title: Software Developer
experience.description: Worked on an ASP.NET and SQL Server package delivery system, responsible for developing and maintaining backend logic, generating application installers (.exe), and implementing OAuth authentication flows for Google and Office 365. Integrated two enterprise systems in .NET Core using XML for cross-company data exchange. Handled backend settlements for various sports betting types in .NET Core, including design and implementation of settlement logic. Designed and built secure REST APIs for scalable and maintainable backends. Acted as a mentor to junior developers on settlement workflows and backend best practices.
